patch_description: The current greedy search is extremely slow (a pure-Python loop over all 165 triples for every candidate move) and stalls immediately, producing a near-zero minimum area. Two targeted improvements: (1) vectorize the minimum-area computation with NumPy (compute all 165 triangle areas at once via a precomputed index array), and (2) replace the fragile greedy step with a fixed-seed simulated-annealing-style random search that perturbs one random point at a time and accepts moves that increase the minimum area (plus rare uphill moves early on). This explores the configuration space far more effectively while keeping determinism via a fixed RNG seed. Early-exit is kept for speed.
